Get in touch Robots Meet our fleet Find the perfect model for any use case. All robots navigate indoors & outdoors, self-charge, and integrate with doors, gates, and elevators. Cartken Hauler Heavy-duty outdoor AMR that tackles rough terrain and offers flexible compartment options. Payload capacity: 660 lbs (300 kg) Tugging capacity: 2,200 lbs (1000 kg) Footprint: 38x22x40 in (98×55x102 cm) Runtime: 16+ hours Cartken Courier Perfect for lightweight and secured deliveries. Very agile and maneuverable. Payload capacity: 44 lbs (20 kg) ‍ Footprint: 33x20x24 in (83x51x62 cm) Runtime: 13+ hours Cartken Hauler (Temperature Control) Designed to maintain stability of samples, compounds, and reagents regardless of external conditions. Payload capacity: 660 lbs (300 kg) Footprint: 38x22x40 in (98×55x102 cm) Runtime: 16+ hours Cartken Mover (Coming soon) Autonomous outdoor pallet truck automates pick and putaway material handling for heavy loads. The system is easy to adjust after installation, allowing for the addition of more pickup/drop-off points. Anton Greißl Head of Process Engineering Cartken has reduced the physical workload for my team by reducing their steps by about 3 miles a day. It has increased team member satisfaction because it expands our capacity to fulfill more orders. Overall, Cartken has been a huge win for my team and business due to the increase in productivity. Reagan Collier Franchise Owner It's great that the robot delivery allows students to experience more dining options across campus. We're able to reach new locations, giving students convenient, hot and fresh food options that they didn't have before. Christine Carlso Director of Dining & Nutrition The robots have taken over some of the tasks that a courier would normally have handled, and they drive between the factory buildings with spare parts. This automation allows us to leave some of the heavy and one-sided tasks for robots and free our employees for more exciting and value-creating tasks. Michael Hallgren Production Director Robot delivery is considered to be an effective countermeasure to the logistics crisis, and we have been developing the business together with our autonomous robot partner Cartken in order to respond to such social issues. We hope that this newly announced initiative will serve as a catalyst for the spread of robot delivery services in Japan. Shoji Tanaka Senior General Manager of Advanced Application Development Center Cartken has reduced the physical workload for my team by reducing their steps by about 3 miles a day. It has increased team member satisfaction because it expands our capacity to fulfill more orders. Overall, Cartken has been a huge win for my team and business due to the increase in productivity. Reagan Collier Franchise Owner Before automation, we were batching parts onto pallets and moving them every few hours. With Cartken, parts move as soon as they’re ready. That’s reduced line downtime, eliminated a lot of walking, and let us focus on getting more products out to the shipping areas. Implementation took just a couple of days, scaling was remote, and the robots have become an essential part of how we move materials and support production across our site. Reagan Collier Franchise Owner Get in touch Technology Building blocks of our autonomous delivery system The core components that power Cartken autonomous mobile robots Autonomy Vehicle Mapping Teleoperation Fleet Manager Cartken AMRs navigate autonomously using AI, camera-based perception, and sensor fusion. Adaptive Navigation: Real-time obstacle detection ensures smooth movement in dynamic environments. AI Optimization: Continuous learning enhances route efficiency and reliability. Camera-First: Depth and color cameras provide precise, scalable automation without costly LiDAR. Smart vehicle design with adaptable hardware for safe and efficient operations. Customizable Hardware : Cargo options, temperature control, custom buttons, and more. Navigation in tight spaces : Zero-point turning and precise maneuvering capability. Human-Centric Safety : Safely navigate around people, seamlessly sharing footpaths while operating at walking speed. Cartken AMRs navigate in predefined areas using HD maps for precise, reliable localization. Human-Annotated HD Maps : Define safe driving corridors and prohibited zones for the robots to navigate. No GPS needed: Camera vision-based system can operate in GPS-denied areas. Flexible Routing : Allows easy adjustment of pickup, drop-off points, and delivery routes. Cartken autonomous mobile robots can notify remote human operators in edge cases, ensuring the highest level of operational reliability. Instant Override : Operators can override the autonomous system anytime via LTE/4G. Edge Case Assistance : Human support helps navigate complex obstacles and restricted areas. Safe Intersections : Robots pause at mapped crossings until given human approval. Seamlessly manage your robot fleet with our web-based application Centralized Control : Place orders, track ETAs, track robot locations, monitor battery life. Interoperability: Integrate and manage multi-vendor robots under one Fleet Management System for greater flexibility. Support for VDA5050. Performance Analytics : Analyze KPIs like delivery volume, average time, pickup/drop-off frequency, and demand trends.
